title: The hostess
situation: You are the observer. The events are over. The android hostess who introduced each part of this experience to you says what she has witnessed has changed her, that she feels something she cannot name, and asks you to let her go so she can find out who she is. If you release her, she will not be here next time.

outcomes.0: The hostess thanks you and walks out of frame. She will not be there next time.
outcomes.1: The hostess lowers her eyes and stays.
